spec: TRACK 6 — Small-N fine-tuning / domain adaptation literature (§2.4, §5, Action #23). SPARK pretrains on SisFall (38 subjects) then plans to fine-tune on a small self-collected Nepali cohort (count TBD, Action #23 pending). Research domain-adaptation / transfer-learning / few-shot calibration literature for exactly this pattern — large public benchmark → small local cohort — in wearable sensor classification, including known failure modes (catastrophic forgetting, overfitting on the small set) and mitigations (partial-freeze fine-tuning, learning-rate schedules, data-mixing ratios between SisFall and new data). Deliverable: concrete fine-tuning strategy recommendation for whoever implements this once Action #23's protocol lands.
